WITH status_totals AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval,
         SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scancount,
         SUM(sc.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS gb_per_minute
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
status_rates AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(gb_per_minute) OVER () AS average_rate
  FROM status_totals
)
SELECT healtheval,
       total_scancount,
       gb_per_minute,
       gb_per_minute - average_rate AS rate_minus_average
FROM status_rates
WHERE gb_per_minute > average_rate;

assumptions.assumption: A status with a zero total span has an undefined rate and is excluded; SQLite AVG ignores undefined (NULL) rates when computing the average across statuses.
